verdict.rationale: Skills are plain, open-source markdown files in the public repo ("source of truth, shared verbatim") and a real hands-on install shows a skill folder copied verbatim into a visible `.claude/skills/` directory with readable SKILL.md, plus the installer explicitly warns 'Review skills before use; they run with full agent permissions' — supporting post-install file review and pre-install browsing via GitHub. However there's no dedicated CLI 'list contents before installing' preview feature evidenced beyond browsing the repo, and no first-party tooling for auditing installed skill diffs.  Missing for 10: a built-in pre-install manifest/listing command, and independent confirmation that all installed files (not just one skill) are fully human-readable without needing to inspect the GitHub repo separately.
